entities.summary: Giovanni Battista Bussi de Pretis was an Italian cleric promoted by Pope Pius VI to the rank of cardinal in the consistory of 21 February 1794. He replaced Buenaventura Fernández de Córdoba Spínola as Cardinal-Priest of San Lorenzo in Panisperna.
